Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Stephan Myburgh and Max O'Dowd will open the batting for Netherlands. Doug Bracewell will begin with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! New Zealand have managed to put up a winning total on the board after losing half their side within the first 10 overs. Netherlands will be under pressure coming into bat considering their show with the bat in the previous game. But they will be hoping they bring out their A-game now and to level the series. Stay tuned for the run chase!

Doug Bracewell is down for a chat. He says Latham did well to help past the 250 mark and it is now time to do the job with the ball. Adds that he and Latham re-assist as the wicket was two-paced but they did well to do the job. Tells that he just needs to keep it simple, and use variations.

Netherlands had a dream start to the innings! Fred Klaassen and Logan van Beek were breathing fire at the beginning. They were right on cue with the new ball, and were very disciplined as well. They grabbed five quick wickets within the first Powerplay and put immense pressure on the hosts. However, once Tom Latham and Doug Bracewell were at the crease, the visitors lost their way in the middle. They failed to capitalize on the early wickets they had grabbed and let the game slip away towards the end. Logan van Beek was the leader of the pack, he grabbed 4 wickets in his spell. Netherlands were not at their best with the bat in the previous game, but they will want to step up and try to chase down the target and keep the series alive.

New Zealand were troubled by all the short balls at the start of the innings, they lost 5 wickets within the first 10 overs of the game. Things were looking difficult for them. But Tom Latham, along with Colin de Grandhomme steadied the ship and tried to rebuild the innings, but Colin de Grandhomme, perished soon, in trying to up the ante. It was the partnership of Doug Bracewell and Tom Latham that helped New Zealand recover well. They put together 90 runs and slowly got their side out of trouble. Birthday boy, Tom Latham brought up his 6th ODI century, and his knock has helped the hosts put up a healthy total.

From 32/5 to ending at 264/9! It's been an empathic recovery from New Zealand, and they have one man to thank for that, Tom Latham. It was the captain leading from the front! They would be mighty pleased to put a score of over 260 on the board. Whereas Netherlands will be a tad disappointed after the start they got.
FOUR! Through the gap! Fuller and outside off. Latham squeezes it out through backward point for a boundary. Take a bow, skip! New Zealand end at 264 for 9.
SIX! And again! As if Tom Latham knows what is coming next! A full toss, outside off. Latham is ready to lap it away over fine leg for a biggie.
SIX! 250 up for New Zealand! A full toss, outside off. Latham shuffles and scoops it over fine leg for a biggie.
Three dots! A full ball, outside off. Latham drives it to deep point for no run.
Slower ball, full toss, on off. Latham hammers it to long on and denies the run again.
A full toss, on middle. Latham flicks it to a deep square leg and denies a run.
Brandon Glover will bowl the final over of the innings!
Full ball, on middle, flicked  to square leg for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham lifts it high towards long on, where the fielder takes the catch. Will not be counted since it was a free hit. Two taken!
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Tom Latham misses his flick. Wide given! Free-hit continues!

No ball! Tom Latham is clearly switched on! Superb awareness by the skipper, he gets hit on the pads and the finger goes up but he points out that there is an extra fielder is outside the circle. Full and on off. Latham looks to push it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Latham is running across meanwhile and he points out to the umpire that there is an extra fielder standing outside the circle. No ball given. Free-hit coming up!
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Short and on middle. Tickner misses his pull.
Leg bye! Angling on the pads. Latham misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. It goes to short fine leg for a leg bye.
SIX! Hammered! A length ball, around off. Latham hangs back and pulls it flat and hard over square leg.
A yorker, angling on middle. Tickner does well to dig it out. Tom Latham will take strike now.

OUT! LBW! Looked plumb to the naked eye! A low dipping full toss, around middle and leg. Jamieson looks to push it away but misses and gets hit on the back pad. An appeal and up goes the finger. Kyle Jamieson was running towards the pavilion but takes a late review but burns it as the Ball Tracking shows three reds. Netherlands making sure the tail-enders do not wag much.
Review! Kyle Jamieson has reviewed an LBW decision. UltraEdge shows the impact was in line and the wickers were hitting. Kyle Jamieson departs!
A full toss, outside off. Latham again tries to paddle it away but miscues it completely and the ball rolls to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! What a shot! Innovation! This is on a length and outside off. Latham shuffles way across, gets low and paddles it all the way over square leg for a biggie.
Fuller and outside off. Latham lofts it to deep cover where the ball drops safely and the batters get two runs.
Fullish and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Jamieson fends it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off, slashed to deep point for a run.
Length ball, on middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, following Latham on the leg side. He pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Kyle Jamieson walks out to bat.
OUT! TAKEN! A full ball, angling on middle. Sodhi looks to heave it but gets a top edge, in the air to covers where Vikramjit Singh holds onto it. A good cameo from Ish Sodhi comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Vikramjit Singh b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on the pads. Latham clips it to fine leg, uppishly and for a single.
Fred Klaassen is back into the attack.
A full ball, outside off. Latham goes inside out to deep covers. A good shot but for only a single.
A low dipping yorker, on off. Sodhi knocks it to covers for a run.
Wide! Bangs a slower bouncer, outside off. Sodhi leaves it alone. A wide given for height.
Touch fuller and outside off. Latham drives it uppishly and to deep point for a single.
Another superb yorker, outside off. Latham shuffles across and looks to squeeze it out but fails to do so.
A widish yorker, outside off. Latham fails to jam it out.
Wide! Length ball, going with the angle outside off. Latham leaves it alone.
A length ball, outside off. Sodhi guides it through point for a single.
Logan van Beek is back on.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Ish Sodhi works it away wide of long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Ish Sodhi tries to upper cut this but he misses.
SIX! BOOM! Ish Sodhi shows some aggression now! A shorter ball, outside off. Ish Sodhi pulls it over long on for a maximum.
On a length, outside off. Tom Latham stays in his crease and cuts it towards third man. Single taken!
Another pitched delivery, outside off. Ish Sodhi once again drives it towards cover. A single now!
Fuller ball, outside off. Ish Sodhi drives it towards sweeper cover. Two runs!
Tad shorter, spinning in, around offf. Ish Sodhi pushes it towards cover for a single. He retains the strike!
Quicker, outside off, fuller ball. Ish Sodhi stays back and tries to cut but he misses.
Loopy ball, around middle, fuller in length. Ish Sodhi pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Very full again, around middle. Ish Sodhi taps it towards extra cover.
Full, around middle. Ish Sodhi blocks it out.

There it is! A loopy ball, full, around middle. Tom Latham eases it down to long on for a single. Century for Tom Latham on his birthday! His 6th ODI hundred. What an important knock this has been! A classy ton from him and he will hope to carry on till the end.
Fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham knocks it towards long on for a single. 99 now!
Shorter ball, outside off. Ish Sodhi punches it towards cover for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Ish Sodhi defends it out.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Tom Latham works it away past square leg for a single.
FOUR! Gets hold of it this time! Another shorter ball, around middle and leg. Tom Latham swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. He moves to 97 now!
In the air... and just short! A shorter ball, around middle. Tom Latham pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder there runs forward and dives but fails to reach the ball. Two taken!
Full, loopy ball, around middle. Ish Sodhi blocks it out.
Tad shorter, around middle. Tom Latham knocks it towards long on for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Tom Latham blocks it out watchfully.
Turning in, around middle and leg. Ish Sodhi flicks it past square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, around off. Tom Latham pushes it towards cover for a single. He moves to 90 now!
SIX! Poor delivery and punished! Too short on this occasion, around middle. Tom Latham rocks back, swivels, and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie!
Tosses it up, fuller again, around off. Ish Sodhi guides it towards short third man.
Slower through the air, loopy ball, outside off. Ish Sodhi taps it towards short third man.
Pitches it up, around middle. Ish Sodhi pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Tad shorter again, around middle, slower through the air. Ish Sodhi defends it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball, spinning in, around middle and leg. Ish Sodhi tucks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Extra bounce there! Outside off, fuller in length. Ish Sodhi taps it towards point off the back foot.
A flighted ball, on off, pushed to point for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Slightly short and on off. Latham slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Defended out.
Ish Sodhi comes to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! A crucial wicket at a crucial time for Netherlands! An arm ball, from over the wicket. It is full and spinning back in. Bracewell looks to go over mid off but plays with the inside half of the bat and to long on where Brandon Glover charges forward and to his right and takes a diving catch. Superb catch and Netherlands break the 90-run stand.
Commentary.Howout: c Brandon Glover b Michael Rippon

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, flicked to square leg for one.
Very full and outside off. Bracewell squeezes it out but straight to backward point.
On a length, on off. Steered to third man for a run.
Wide! Again! Glover misses his line and puts it down the leg side. Latham misses his flick.
Wide! Short and angling down. Latham misses his pull.
Short of a length, outside off. Latham punches it on the back foot but straight to the fielder at point.
Full and outside off. Latham drives it beautifully to deep point. Two runs now.
Fuller and on off. Bracewell looks to push through covers but mistimes it to mid-wicket. A single.
Length and on off. Latham guides it to short third man for a single.
Brandon Glover (5-0-26-0) is brought back into the attack.
A googly to end the over, outside off. Bracewell looks to push but fails to read the spin.
Flatter, slower one and this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter and spinning back in. Bracewell punches it to cover for a quick single.
Flighted, full and on off, pushed back to Rippon.
FOUR! New Zealand changing the gears now! Short again, outside off. Bracewell cuts it very late past point for a boundary.
Short and on off. Latham pulls it hard but straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the hips, this is hit to deep square leg for a single. 15 coming off the over.
Michael Rippon (6-0-24-0) is back on!
Wide! A short ball, was a bit too short for the umpire's liking and he signals a wide.
Around off, Bracewell strokes it to mid on for a single.
SIX! Bang! Very full, dipping into the batter and was the slower ball. Bracewell has all the time as he hammers it over long off for a biggie.
Length ball, on off. Bracewell mistimes his push on the leg side.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Birthday boy enjoying himself! This is on the pads, too straight and Latham just tickles it away to fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Short one, down the leg side. Latham leaves it alone.
This one spins away after landing around off. Latham plays with the turn to point for a single.
Flatter and on off. Bracewell charges down and tucks it to square leg for a quick single.
Outside off again, played to deep point for a single.
Shorter and outside off, this is hit to point.
This is full and outside off. Latham tries to reverse sweep with the back of the bat but the ball was way out of his reach.
Full and on off. Latham smashes it to the left of mid on where the fielder dives and half-stops it. Two runs taken.
Fuller ball, outside off. Doug Bracewell drives it towards cover.
Back of a length, around middle. Tom Latham pulls it towards fine leg. Brandon Glover runs to his right, dives early, and makes a good stop. Single taken! He saved three runs for his team there!
Fuller ball, outside off. Doug Bracewell drives it past cover for a single.
On a length, around middle. Doug Bracewell blocks it out.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Tom Latham works it away towards square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Doug Bracewell dabs it towards point for a single.

NOT OUT! A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no! A slower ball, turning away a tad, around middle. Tom Latham gets down on his knee and tries to sweep but he misses and gets hit on his thing pad. Netherlands opts for a review!  No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows the ball was missing wickets. It was too high! Tom Latham survives.
Review! Netherlands take a review for LBW! UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows wickets missing as the ball bounced over the stumps.

Outside off, fuller ball. Tom Latham hangs back, opens the face of the back, and guides it towards short third man, the fielder there fumbles, and the batters grab two runs. That brings up the 50-run partnership between these two! A crucial stand for New Zealand!
Turning in outside off, fuller ball. Doug Bracewell cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker ball, outside off, fuller in length. Doug Bracewell cuts it towards point.
Turning it away from the left-hander, outside off, fullish ball. Tom Latham pushes it through over for a single.
Back of a length, spinning in, around middle. Doug Bracewell knocks it towards long on for a single.

Drinks! New Zealand have done pretty well from the last drinks break. Still behind in the game but a score around 250 is very possible if Latham sticks around till the end. This partnership now moves to 46.
Flatter ball, around middle. Doug Bracewell punches it towards long on off the back foot for a single.
Fuller ball, turning in, on the pads. Tom Latham tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller ball, around middle and off. Tom Latham shimmies down the pitch and lifts it gently over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle. Tom Latham pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Tad shorter now, around middle and leg. Doug Bracewell knocks it down to long on off the back foot for a single.
Spinning in, around middle, fullish ball. Tom Latham flicks it towards square leg. Single taken!
FOUR! Shorter ball, wide of off this time. Doug Bracewell stays back and punches it past cover for a boundary.
Slower this time, fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, fuller ball. Tom Latham slashes it towards the fielder at point.
Fullish delivery, around middle and off. Doug Bracewell punches it towards long off for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle. Doug Bracewell taps it to mid-wicket.
Aryan Dutt begins with a loopy ball, full, outside off. Doug Bracewell pushes it towards cover.
Fuller ball, around middle. Doug Bracewell tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, around off, fuller ball. Doug Bracewell pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, around off. Doug Bracewell taps it towards point.
SIX! BANG! That was gone a long way! A fuller ball, around middle. Doug Bracewell dances down the pitch and smashes it way straight down the ground for a biggie!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Tom Latham tucks it towards mid-wicket for single.
Shortish ball, around middle. Tom Latham advances down the pitch and taps it towards mid on.

Fifty for Tom Latham! Finally, he gets that run and also his 17th ODI half-century! Short in length and on middle, Latham pulls it to deep square leg for a single. He keeps the hope alive for New Zealand and if he keeps on batting till the end, anything around 250 is possible.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
Length and on middle. Bracewell is a touch late as he looks to push and gets an inside edge to deep square leg. A single.
On a length and on middle, Bracewell bunts it to mid-wicket. Three dots in a row.
A pacy short ball, on middle. Bracewell ducks under it.
A length ball, on middle, bit of away swing. Bracewell is squared up as he looks to defend and gets an outside edge to point.
Flatter and angling on middle, Latham pushes it to covers. He has to wait for the milestone for yet another over.
A loopy ball, outside off. Tom charges forward and drills it to mid-wicket.
Now goes full and on middle. Bracewell tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Tad short and on middle. Bracewell makes room and punches it to covers.
An arm ball, sliding on middle, pushed to mid on.
Floated, on middle. Blocked out.
Full ball, on middle, was the slower one. Latham eases it to mid-wicket for no run.
In the slot, on middle, Latham hits it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Bracewell dabs it to third man for a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Bracewell bends his back and tries to ramp it away but misses it completely.
Touch fuller and on middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
On a length, on middle. Doug wrists it to mid-wicket.
Fred Klaassen (6-0-16-2) comes back into the attack.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on middle, Bracewell works it to covers.
Tossed up, on off. Latham taps it to point and takes a quick single. He moves to 49 now.
FOUR! This is full and angling on middle. Latham reverse sweeps it to point and the fielder dives over the ball and lets it through for a boundary.
Too full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fuller and on off. Latham skips down and drives it to the right of mid off. 100 up for the Kiwis!
An arm ball, googly as well. Bracewell takes a big stride forward and defends it.
Very full and on middle, swept to fine leg for a single.
A loopy ball, on off, pushed to covers.
Around off, it is hit to point.
A short ball from wide of the crease. Bracewell cuts it to deep point for a single.
An arm ball, outside off. Bracewell looks to defend but gets an outside edge to point.
Full, around middle. Tom Latham pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Doug Bracewell pushes it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham steps down the pitch and knocks it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, fuller in length, around middle. Tom Latham blocks it out.
Flatter, floated on off, pushed to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, drilled down to long on for one.
Tad shorter, around middle. Tom Latham knocks it towards long on for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Tom Latham pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
1 run, played towards square leg.
No run, played towards mid off. Sorry for the inconvience caused. We have lost the live stream due to some technical issue.
Tad shorter, around middle. Doug Bracewell pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, on middle, fuller ball. Tom Latham sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham drives it towards long on for a single.
Doug Bracewell comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Pieter Seelaar strikes and breaks this partnership. New Zealand lose their sixth wicket now! Colin de Grandhomme departs now. A shorter ball, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme swivels and pulls this, but the ball goes off the top edge and flies high on the leg side. The keeper, Scott Edwards runs forward towards square and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Pieter Seelaar

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, full, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme dabs it towards point.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Colin de Grandhomme pushes it towards cover.
Shortish ball, around middle. Tom Latham taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, loopy delivery, outside off. Tom Latham steps down the pitch and lifts it over cover. The ball will not race away to the boundary, but the batters pick up two runs.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Tom Latham tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Full, outside off. Tom Latham drives this firmly and finds the fielder at cover.
Angling in on the pads, fuller in length. Colin de Grandhomme works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Brandon Glover drops it short now, wide of off. Colin de Grandhomme once again tries to go over third man, but fails to get any bat on it. Wide given!
Pitches it up this time, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme pushes it with the inner half of his bat towards mid on.
Shorter ball, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme stays in his crease and looks to slash this over third man, but he misses.
FOUR! A gift for Colin de Grandhomme! On a length, down leg. Colin de Grandhomme tucks it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Colin de Grandhomme misses his flick. Wide called!
Fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham blocks it out. 2 runs off Pieter Seelaar's first over!
Tosses it up, full, around off. Colin de Grandhomme leans and eases it down to long off for a single.
Short ball, around off. Colin de Grandhomme pushes it towards mid on off the off the back foot.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, full, around off. Colin de Grandhomme drives it toward cover.
Tad shorter, spinning in on the pads. Tom Latham tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Tom Latham defends it out off the front foot.
Pieter Seelaar brings himself into the attack.
Slower through the air, slightly fuller and on off. de Grandhomme leans and blocks it.
A loopy ball, angling on leg. Latham sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Tom hits it to deep point for a brace.
Around off. Kept out.
FOUR! Exclusive form Latham! Floated, full and outside off. Latham comes down the track and converts it into a full toss, full face of the bat and driven through covers for a boundary.
Too full and on middle. Defended on the front foot.
Sharp fielding! Length ball, outside off. de Grandhomme cuts it to point where the fielder dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Length and on off. de Grandhomme punches with soft hands to covers.
A short ball, outside off. de Grandhomme is tempted at first but leaves it alone.
On the hips, flicked to deep backward square leg for a single.
Way outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! Two is the call but Latham will get four there! Full and way outside off. Latham strides forward and drives it to deep cover. The fielder runs to his left, dives but fails to keep it away.
A friendly full toss on middle. Latham takes the charge and looks to make the most of it but mistimes his heave to deep mid-wicket and will only get a single.
Flatter and on off. Latham pushes it back to Rippon.
This one lands on off and spins back in.  de Grandhomme rocks back and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, swept to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Latham looks in good touch! Full ball, on off. Latham skips down and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted, full and on off. de Grandhomme leans and looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to backward point. A single.
Leg bye! Length ball, angling on the pads. de Grandhomme misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. It goes to square leg for a leg bye to finish the over.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off. Latham punches it late to deep point for a single.
Angles it on the pads. de Grandhomme bunts it to deep square leg for one.
Full ball and on off, pushed to covers.
On middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shorter and on off, this is punched to covers.

How has that missed the stumps? This is short and outside off, this one lands and spins back in. de Grandhomme goes back and looks to punch it but misses and the ball just whizzes past the off stump. Rippon is down on his knee holding his head.
Fuller and on off, driven to covers where the fielder makes a good stop.
Touch short and on middle. Latham pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Full and on the pads. Grandhomme flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.

Drinks! It is all Netherlands at the moment. They have taken 5 wickets and are on the moon right now, they are also keeping it tight and not allowing any room to relax. New Zealand need some calmess out in the middle and who better than the skipper himself.
Tad shorter this time, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Tom Latham lunges forward and taps it towards cover for a quick single.
FOUR! Glorious drive! A low full toss, around off. Tom Latham leans and creams his drive past cover for a boundary.
Full again, outside off. Tom Latham drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme slashes it towards deep point. Single taken!
Very full this time, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme drives it towards mid on. No run there!
Spinning away from the right-hander, outside off. Tom Latham taps it towards point off the back foot.
A googly this time, on the pads, fuller ball. Colin de Grandhomme tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy delivery, around middle, full in length. Colin de Grandhomme pushes it back to the bowler.
Full again, spinning in, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme blocks it out.
Tosses it up, around middle, full again. Tom Latham gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Michael Rippon begins with a fuller ball, slower through the air, on middle. Tom Latham pushes it towards mid off.
Michael Rippon is brought into the attack.
Well bowled and a good leave! On a length, nipping back in around the fourth stump line. Colin de Grandhomme does not fiddle with it.
Another length delivery, tailing back in, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme offer no shot!
Back of a length, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme defends it out off the back foot.
On a length, outside off. Tom Latham stays in crease and dabs it towards third man. Single taken!
Wide! Good-length delivery, down the leg side. Tom Latham leaves it alone. Wide called!
Pitches it up this time, outside off. Tom Latham drives it towards cover.
Brandon Glover begins with a fuller ball, angling in, on the pads. Colin de Grandhomme flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Brandon Glover comes into the attack.
Fuller again, outside off. Tom Latham drives it towards mid off.
Very full on the occasion, around middle. Tom Latham does well to squeeze it out.
Fuller ball, around middle. Tom Latham drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Fraction short again, outside off. Tom Latham dabs it towards point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! An overpitched delivery, around middle. Tom Latham shows the full face of his bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle. Tom Latham blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Tom Latham leaves it alone.

In the air...and just short! Netherlands nearly had their sixth wicket! Another shorter ball, around middle. Colin de Grandhomme miscues his pull shot towards mid on. The fielder there moves to his right and dives but fails to get there. Single taken!
Beaten! Outside off, on a length, shaping away. Colin de Grandhomme looks to block this but he misses.
Angling in, shorter ball, around middle and off. Colin de Grandhomme leaves it alone.
Shorter ball, outside off. Colin de Grandhomme leans back and leaves it alone.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed to be placed outside the circle till the 40th over!
On a length, on middle. Latham blocks it.
Fuller and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Colin de Grandhomme comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! No one saw this coming, I bet no one! New Zealand are absolutely shaking and it is the short ball and the extra bounce that does the trick! Another superb short ball, on middle and steep bounce offered. Bracewell looks to pull but gets a leading edge to fine leg where Fred Klaassen takes an easy catch. New Zealand are 5 down in no time.
Commentary.Howout: c Fred Klaassen b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker now, on middle. Bracewell does well to squeeze it out on the off side.
On middle, played back to van Beek.
Fullish and on off. Bracewell steps across and pushes it to the bowler.
Bangs a bouncer and on middle. Latham sits under it.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off. Bracewell steps across and tucks it to mid on for a single.
Michael Bracewell comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Netherlands are on a roll and in the driving seat! Short in length and keeping it tight around off, there is extra bounce as well. Ross Taylor looks to defend but the ball bounces a touch more and takes the shoulder of the bat and lobs to Logan van Beek who charges in from gully to take it. New Zealand are well and truly under pressure.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off. Ross keeps it out.
A slower short ball, on middle. Taylor gets deceived by the lack of pace and mistimes it completely.

No ball! Just didn't carry! A length ball, outside off. Taylor defends with soft hands and gets an outside edge, well short of the fielder at first slip. A no ball called for overstepping and a Free hit will follow.
Fuller and on off. Latham drives it to covers.
Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! What a start this is for Netherlands! Poor shot selection so far from New Zealand. Short of a length, on middle, the ball just skids through. Henry Nicholls pre-meditates the length but is late as he pulls it, no timing on his shot and an easy catch for Vikramjit Singh at short square leg. New Zealand are in trouble early on!
Commentary.Howout: c Vikramjit Singh b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off. Nicholls punches it to covers.
On a length, on off. Henry Nicholls defends it out.
Full ball, on middle. A lovely on drive from Taylor but even better fielding by the fielder at mid on as he dives to his left and stops it from running away. Just a single.
Length ball, on middle, pushed to mid on.
Henry Nicholls played all around it. Short of a length, just around off. Nicholls makes room and looks to slash at it but misses and the ball was inches away from hitting the off stump.
Length ball, on middle. Henry Nicholls keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off. Nicholls guides it to point.
Around off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Short of a length, on off. Nicholls looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! A short ball, outside off. Nicholls looks to pull but gets a top edge and flies over the keeper for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Defended out on the leg side.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to mid off.
On a length and on off. Blocked out.
Full ball, on middle. Taylor does well to dig it out.
Ross Taylor walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! BOWLED! Can you believe it? What a bizarre way to get out. A length ball, slanting around off. Young shuffles way across and looks to pull but misses and gets hit on his thigh pads. The ball lobs up off his thigh pads, hits him on his elbow, and rolls back onto the stumps. The ball had enough pace to shake the leg pole and the centurion from the previous game goes for just a run this time. Young is disappointed as he walks back. A perfect start for Netherlands!
A length ball, angling on middle, tucked to square leg.
Beaten! Fred Klaassen drops it short this time, outside off. Henry Nicholls hops and tries to go over third man, but he misses. End of a successful over by Fred Klaassen!
Angling in, around middle and leg and on a length. Henry Nicholls tucks it past square leg for a brace.
On a length, around middle and leg. Will Young works it away past mid-wicket for a single. He gets off the mark!
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Will Young dabs it towards point.
On a length, around middle. Will Young defends this one off the back foot.
Will Young is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fred Klaassen strikes and draws first blood. This is a big wicket and this is just what Netherlands wanted. An early breakthrough! A fuller ball, outside off. Martin Guptill leans and drives it uppishly with the bottom half of his bat. The ball lobs up and goes towards cover. Bas de Leede dives to his left and takes a stunning catch. Martin Guptill walks back to the hut!
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: Another beauty! This one lands on a length, nips back in a tad, around off. Henry Nicholls looks to defend this one, but he misses and the ball sneaks past his inside edge.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller this time, around middle. Henry Nicholls lifts it over mid on. The fielder chases the ball, but the ball wins the race. Boundary!
Beaten! Well bowled! On a length, shaping away, outside off, at 134.1 clicks. Henry Nicholls looks to block this, but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length, around middle. Henry Nicholls blocks it out.
Leg bye! Angling in, on the pads, on a length. Martin Guptill looks to tuck this, but he misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
FOUR! Third boundary off the short ball! Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Martin Guptill pulls it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Henry Nicholls taps it towards point.
Extra bounce there! On a length, around middle and off. Henry Nicholls stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller in length. Henry Nicholls looks to flick this but he misses. Wide called!
On a length, around middle. Henry Nicholls defends it out.
FOUR! Top shot! Very short on this occasion, down leg. Henry Nicholls swivels and hooks this towards fine leg for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Henry Nicholls flicks but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Tad fuller now, shaping away, around off. Henry Nicholls pushes it towards cover.
Fuller ball this time, around off. Henry Nicholls taps it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Shorter ball, around middle. Henry Nicholls pulls and finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a length, around middle and leg. Henry Nicholls nudges it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Henry Nicholls misses his flick. Wide called!
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A shorter ball, around middle. Henry Nicholls pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary. Henry Nicholls gets off the mark in style!
Angling in, around middle, on a length. Martin Guptill tucks it through square leg for a single.
Logan van Beek begins with a length ball, swinging in, outside off. Martin Guptill leaves it alone.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Logan van Beek.
Fraction shorter this time, outside off. Henry Nicholls taps it towards point off the back foot. 1 run off the first over!
Good-length delivery, swinging away, outside off. Henry Nicholls lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length now, shaping away, outside off. Henry Nicholls leaves it alone.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Henry Nicholls leans and drives it towards mid off.
Full in length, around middle. Martin Guptill pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end for a single. Martin Guptill and New Zealand are underway!
Starts with a fuller delivery and way outside off. Guptill gets low and drives it straight to covers.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls are the openers for New Zealand. Fred Klaassen to open with the ball.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Will Young, Ross Taylor, Tom Latham (C/WK), Michael Bracewell, Colin de Grandhomme, Doug Bracewell (In for Matt Henry), Ish Sodhi, Kyle Jamieson, Blair Tickner.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Pieter Seelaar (C), Max O'Dowd, Michael Rippon, Scott Edwards (WK), Bas de Leede, Logan van Beek, Vikramjit Singh, Aryan Dutt (In for Philippe Boissevain), Stephan Myburgh, Fred Klaassen, Brandon Glover.
TOSS - Netherlands have won the toss and opted to BOWL first!

Netherlands did put up a fight and they proved to be competitive against the Kiwis. They will be hoping that this time around their top order can chip in with some vital runs and provide them with a good start. They will aim to leave their wounds from the first ODI behind and put a better performance in Hamilton. Will the visitors clinch victory this time? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

New Zealand put up a complete performance in the previous game, they dismissed the visitors for a below-par score and Will Young’s sublime century ensured that they come out on top comfortably. They will want to stick to their plans and replicate the same kind of show and clinch the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second ODI of the three-match series between New Zealand and Netherlands. We witnessed the hosts put up a dominating performance in the first match and get over the line with ease. Netherlands will want to put their best foot forward in this must-win encounter and keep the series alive.
... MATCH DAY ...
